picks.title: Luke Was Not a Disciple: An Introduction to the Gospel of Luke
picks.summary:
Luke Was Not a Disciple: An Introduction to the Gospel of Luke



We're starting our fall study of the Gospel of Luke, and before we open the text, it's worth knowing who wrote this book and why. Luke was a physician, a careful historian, and the only non-Jewish author in all of Scripture. He wasn't one of the twelve. He never met Jesus. And he wrote for someone who had already heard the stories but needed something solid underneath them.If you have ever felt like an outsider in church, or found that your own faith has gotten a little shakier than you'd like to admit, this is your gospel.

picks.reason: Introduction to Luke's Gospel with historical and theological context.

picks.title: From Aladdin to the Old Testament: Mena Massoud on 'Daniel and the Fiery Furnace'
picks.summary:
Best known for starring in Disney's live-action Aladdin (2019), Egyptian born Canadian actor Mena Massoud now takes on a biblical role as the Old Testament prophet Daniel. In the movie Daniel and the Fiery Furnace, Daniel and his friends Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego face King Nebuchadnezzar’s ultimatum: compromise their faith or be cast into a fiery furnace. On this episode of the Lighthouse Faith podcast, Mena discusses the film and how his Coptic Christian background helped him bring the biblical figure to life.
Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices
picks.reason: Actor discusses biblical story of Daniel and faith under pressure.
